newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Luxton favours means-tested pension.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Luxton favours means-tested pension.

text.p: Commerce Minister John Luxton said on Thursday he would prefer a means-tested superannuation scheme.
"My personal view... is we should go back to a means tested benefit and people take their own responsibility in retirement," Luxton told Parliament's Commerce select committee.
He said a move to a compulsory scheme would distort investment patterns.
"You will see changes like 70 percent of New Zealanders now own their own housing dropping maybe to the European norm of 35 to 40 percent."
